title: Color Picker
description: A curated palette first, any color second — swatches for the 95% case, a native picker for the rest.
usage: For brand colors, labels and categories — anywhere the right answer is usually one of a few known colors. Free-form color fields invite off-brand chaos; the palette is the point.
a11y: Swatches are radio inputs in disguise: one selected, arrow keys move, the choice is announced. The custom tile is a native color input, so the full picker is the platform one.
